label: full-V03
brief: A 45-second widescreen (16:9) YouTube ad for Ridgeview Zoo in three clips with a warm, friendly voice-over: lions at dawn, then penguins being fed, then giraffes at the treetops; end on a clean logo card that reads exactly 'Ridgeview Zoo' in green and gold with a simple antelope mark and the line 'Open daily 9–5 · Kids under 5 free'. The voice-over invites families to visit this weekend.

clip-1.prompt: Create a 15-second text-to-video wildlife-film opening featuring Leo, a tawny lion with a dark mane and amber eyes, at Ridgeview Zoo’s Dawn Meadow, in 16:9; this is clip 1 of 4. Use photoreal natural-history cinematography, low golden dawn light, a welcoming mood, detailed fur and sandstone textures, and gentle, relaxed energy. Four shots maintain the same Leo, the same meadow, and the same sunrise direction throughout. 0–3 s: wide establishing view of Leo, anchored by his dark mane, resting on a sandstone ledge above a broad grass habitat; the eastern ridge forms a low silhouette across the far background, with the rising sun just behind it; glide slowly forward as sunlight grazes the ledges. 3–7 s: medium-wide view of Leo, dark mane distinct against the grass, lifting his head in one unhurried movement; dew-bright grass fills the ground below his ledge; continue a smooth, shallow push toward him. 7–11 s: medium close-up of Leo, amber eyes clearly visible, blinking once into the morning light; a softly blurred sandstone shelf sits behind him; make a subtle lateral slide that reveals warm rim light along his mane. 11–15 s: slightly wider medium close-up of Leo, dark mane framing his face and front paws visible at the lower edge, stretching both front paws forward once during 11–13 s; soft green meadow bokeh fills the background; ease the camera forward and settle by 13 s, holding his still, calm, watchful face in a clear composition for the final two seconds. Audio off: no narration, music, or ambient sound. No on-screen words. Grade with golden highlights, natural greens, gentle contrast, and consistent dawn exposure; keep the cuts soft in feeling and the pacing unhurried. Negatives: no Penguin Cove, penguins, giraffe, visitors, later-clip events, midday transition, titles, subtitles, logos, exaggerated animal behavior, or distorted anatomy.

story.setting: Ridgeview Zoo is a welcoming, leafy wildlife park shown from dawn into a bright weekend morning. The film is widescreen 16:9 throughout. Dawn Meadow is a broad grass habitat bordered by sandstone ledges, with the rising sun behind its eastern ridge. Leo, a tawny lion with a dark mane and amber eyes, rests above the grass. Beyond the meadow, Penguin Cove is a blue pool edged by pale rocks and a low feeding platform. Pip and Pebble, two black-and-white penguins with orange beaks and pink feet, wait beside the water. Farther along the visitor path, Treetop Terrace is a tall acacia grove behind a timber viewing rail. Acacia, a long-necked giraffe with chestnut patches and small tufted horns, browses its branches. Golden highlights, natural greens, gentle contrast, and unhurried camera movement unite the film. A warm, friendly narrator addresses families; no other sound is heard.

clips.paragraph: A wide view reveals Dawn Meadow as sunlight reaches the sandstone ledges. The camera glides closer to Leo, a tawny lion with a dark mane and amber eyes. He lifts his head, blinks into the light, and stretches his front paws. A medium close-up catches warm light along his mane. The narrator says, "This weekend, trade the everyday for a little wonder at Ridgeview Zoo. Start with golden morning light, a magnificent lion, and that lovely feeling of discovering something together, right here with the people you love." End on his calm, watchful face.

clips.reference_why: This is a new location and moment that needs no visual reference from the preceding shot.
clips.paragraph: Cut to a wide view of Penguin Cove, with the feeding platform beside the blue pool. Pip and Pebble, two black-and-white penguins with orange beaks and pink feet, waddle toward a short feeding chute. Fish slide onto the platform; each bird picks one up and swallows. The camera lowers to their eye level as they turn toward the water. The narrator says, "Then meet our penguins at feeding time, where quick little steps become a splash of excitement. There are curious faces, wonderful discoveries, and plenty of moments your family will be talking about all the way home." End as they slip into the pool.

narration.script: This weekend, trade the everyday for a little wonder at Ridgeview Zoo. Start with golden morning light, a magnificent lion, and that lovely feeling of discovering something together, right here with the people you love. Then meet our penguins at feeding time, where quick little steps become a splash of excitement. There are curious faces, wonderful discoveries, and plenty of moments your family will be talking about all the way home. Look up, and share a treetop moment with our giraffe. Make this weekend a family adventure at Ridgeview Zoo. We're open daily, nine to five, and kids under five are free. Come explore together this weekend.
